title: Dune Allen "Sol Sisters" 119 Baird Road
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Walk to the beach- Panoramic Gulf views- Private heated pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1 through May 1 for $50 per day**- Newly remodeled expansive outdoor area- Covered hot tub- Multiple private decks- 6 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Putting green and golf clubs- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutThis home boasts a newly remodeled exterior and entertainment area, including an updated pool, covered outdoor kitchen, grill and bar area, covered built-in hot tub, fire pit, and large putting green.DETAILS: Sol Sisters is a beautifully designed 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom Dune Allen retreat that sleeps 20. Known for coastal dune lakes and secluded beaches, Dune Allen is the perfect seaside escape. Guests will love this haven’s proximity to the beach and sparkling private pool.A gorgeously updated exterior with Bahama shutters invites guests to leave cares behind upon arrival. Use the outdoor stairs to enter the open-concept great room on the second floor. Sink into the plush sectional sofa and cozy up for a family movie night in front of the 65” TV. Delight in meal prep in the centrally located kitchen, featuring marble countertops and top-of-the-line appliances. Gather at the adjacent dining table for 6 once the feast is ready, with 3 more seats available at the breakfast bar. A guest bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom is on this floor.The third floor has a primary and guest bedroom, both with king beds and balcony access.The top-floor bunk room features 2 sets of built-in twin-over-twin beds, a coffee bar/beverage fridge, and an outdoor porch with gorgeous coastal viewsAccess the basement level via the exterior stairs to discover a beautiful secondary living area, which boasts a large sectional sofa, 55” TV, and a 4-seat dining table—add a deck of cards to make it a game table! The kitchenette is conveniently located for storing drinks and snacks. Choose between a gorgeous guest bedroom with a king bed or a spacious bunk room offering 2 built-in queen-over-queen beds. Steps outside, find the newly updated outdoor entertainment areas. Splash in the private pool with a waterfall, relax under the covered pavilion—featuring an outdoor kitchen with a grill, refrigerator, ice drawer, bar seating, heater, and TV—and end the day around the firepit! An updated outdoor shower is perfect for rinsing off sand after a quick walk to the beach.Enjoy a spectacular Dune Allen getaway at Sol Sisters. Parking for 4 vehicles—plus 6 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle—make it easy to explore the area. Book this beach retreat today!BASEMENT LEVEL- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyFIRST FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubTHIRD FLOOR- Bunk Area: 2 Twin over Twin Bunk Beds

DETAILS: Sol Sisters is a beautifully designed 5-bedroom, 5-bathroom Dune Allen retreat that sleeps 20. Known for coastal dune lakes and secluded beaches, Dune Allen is the perfect seaside escape. Guests will love this haven’s proximity to the beach and sparkling private pool. A gorgeously updated exterior with Bahama shutters invites guests to leave cares behind upon arrival. Use the outdoor stairs to enter the open-concept great room on the second floor. Sink into the plush sectional sofa and cozy up for a family movie night in front of the 65” TV. The third floor has a primary and guest bedroom, both with king beds and balcony access. The kitchenette is conveniently located for storing drinks and snacks. Choose between a gorgeous guest bedroom with a king bed or a spacious bunk room offering 2 built-in queen-over-queen beds. Steps outside, find the newly updated outdoor entertainment areas. Splash in the private pool with a waterfall, relax under the covered pavilion—featuring an outdoor kitchen with a grill, refrigerator, ice drawer, bar seating, heater, and TV—and end the day around the firepit! An updated outdoor shower is perfect for rinsing off sand after a quick walk to the beach. Enjoy a spectacular Dune Allen getaway at Sol Sisters. Parking for 4 vehicles—plus 6 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle—make it easy to explore the area. Book this beach retreat today!
